articles.headline: Former Montreal Canadiens owner George Gillett Jr. dies at 87
articles.description: George Gillett Jr., who was a former majority owner of the NHL's Montreal Canadiens and part owner of soccer's Liverpool FC, has died. He was 87.

articles.headline: Mark Messier 'horrified' by Oilers' hire of coach Mike Babcock
articles.description: Former NHL star Mark Messier, who had a Hall of Fame career with the Edmonton Oilers, said he was "horrified" by the team's hiring of controversial coach Mike Babcock.

images.name: Mike Babcock [600x400]
images.credit: James Maclennan/The Canadian Press via AP

articles.headline: ASU's Greg Powers: 'Right guy' despite Matthew Mayich collapse
articles.description: Arizona State head hockey coach Greg Powers declined to answer questions Wednesday about a player's collapse during a team workout last month but says he still believes he is the right person to lead the team.

articles.headline: Sabres' Mattias Samuelsson injured, may miss start of season
articles.description: Sabres defenseman Mattias Samuelsson is listed as week to week with a lower-body injury, leaving him in jeopardy of missing the start of the season.
